Blocks.Section: RSC & Basic Job Post are enabled for a customer
SectionPath: RSC & Basic Job Post are enabled for a customer
Blocks.Text: Upon the posting of a Basic API Job, it will be automatically published on LinkedIn making it accessible to all members. The job will also be integrated into RSC, enabling recruiters to source candidates through One Click Export as long as the job is configured for recruiter visibility.

Blocks.Section: RSC & Premium Job Post are enabled for a customer
SectionPath: RSC & Premium Job Post are enabled for a customer
Blocks.Text: Upon the posting of a Premium API Job, it will be automatically published on LinkedIn making it accessible to all members. However, this job will not be integrated into RSC nor will it be visible within One Click Export.

Blocks.Section: Inline Upgrade / Downgrade impact on API Jobs & RSC
SectionPath: RSC & Premium Job Post are enabled for a customer
Inline Upgrade / Downgrade impact on API Jobs & RSC
Blocks.Text: When an API Job is designated as Basic, either by creating a new Basic API Job or by inline downgrading a Premium API Job, it will be visible in the RSC.

Blocks.Section: Inline Upgrade / Downgrade impact on API Jobs & RSC
SectionPath: RSC & Premium Job Post are enabled for a customer
Inline Upgrade / Downgrade impact on API Jobs & RSC
Blocks.Text: Inline upgrading a Basic API Job to a Premium Job does not change its visibility in the RSC; the job remains visible until it is closed.

Blocks.Section: Inline Upgrade / Downgrade impact on API Jobs & RSC
SectionPath: RSC & Premium Job Post are enabled for a customer
Inline Upgrade / Downgrade impact on API Jobs & RSC
Blocks.Text: Similarly, inline downgrading a Premium API Job to a Basic Job will make the job appear in the RSC. No updates to an API Job, except for the CLOSE action, are sent to the RSC.
